name: B10-0482/2026 (PPE) – Escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an end to attacks by the Houthis, an armed group backed by Iran, on Saudi Arabia and on ships in the Red Sea. It asks the Houthis to stop fighting and respect international law. It wants the European Union to work more closely with Gulf countries on defence, give more aid to Yemen's people, and consider putting the Houthis on the European Union's list of terrorist organisations. This is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the European Union's foreign policy chief to propose listing the Houthis as terrorists.
- **Who it affects:** Saudi Arabia, Yemen's people, Gulf states, Iran, and shipping in the Red Sea.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the European Union's foreign policy chief, the Commission, the Council and others for follow-up.
